findings.title: Manager image is selected through a mutable latest tag
findings.what: The Deployment specifies image: controller:latest. A mutable tag can resolve to different bytes across installs or restarts, defeating reproducibility and allowing registry-side tag replacement to alter the running operator without a manifest change.
findings.fix: Replace the mutable tag with an immutable image digest and ensure consuming overlays retain a digest-pinned reference.
findings.acceptance: Render each supported deployment composition and assert the manager image is of the form registry/repository@sha256:<64-hex-digest>, with no :latest reference in the rendered Deployment.
findings.verifyNote: Second pass re-read line 66 at the specified baseline and confirmed the active Deployment field is controller:latest. As comparison-only support, config/default/kustomization.yaml rewrites it to a published repository but still uses newTag: latest, so the normal overlay does not eliminate mutability.

findings.title: Metrics scrape sends a bearer token without authenticating the TLS peer
findings.what: The active ServiceMonitor sends the Prometheus pod's Kubernetes service-account bearer token but sets insecureSkipVerify: true. An intercepted or misdirected scrape can therefore disclose that token to an unauthenticated TLS peer. The secure TLS patch exists but is not enabled by the kustomization.
findings.fix: Enable monitor_tls_patch.yaml and its required cert-manager secret/replacements so the endpoint uses insecureSkipVerify: false with a verified CA and serverName; alternatively configure equivalent verified TLS without a client credential if bearer authentication is unnecessary.
findings.acceptance: Render the Prometheus kustomization and verify the ServiceMonitor endpoint has insecureSkipVerify: false, a populated CA reference and concrete service serverName, while an HTTPS scrape using the expected certificate succeeds and one using an untrusted certificate fails without receiving the bearer token.
findings.verifyNote: Second pass re-read the baseline: prometheus/kustomization.yaml actively includes monitor.yaml at line 2 while its TLS patch block is commented at lines 8-11; monitor.yaml reads the bearer token at line 16 and disables peer verification at line 23. The batch's monitor_tls_patch.yaml confirms a verified-TLS configuration exists but is not applied.
